2393-4279-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2855-7839-8168.description:
Cast Draconic Visitor by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Draconic Visitor enters, Dragon Tempest's first and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a number of 5/5 Dragon creature tokens due to Draconic Visitor.
When the Dragons enter, Dragon Tempest's first and second ability trigger that many times.
Resolve all of the Dragon Tempest triggers from its first ability, giving the tokens haste until end of turn.
Resolve the first trigger from Dragon Tempest's second ability, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 4.
2855-7839-8168.notes: To get infinite Treasure tokens, target Draconic Visitor with Dragon Tempest triggers once you're done with the combo. Once you kill Draconic Visitor, remaining Dragon Tempest triggers can target Smaug to then make Treasures. These additional triggers can also be directed at other target(s) at your discretion.

141-1854-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-6797.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2738-3220-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Golgari Germination, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2267-2921-3240-6462.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7322.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

141-2511-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

1418-3634-3821.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax minus {1} if applicable.
1418-3634-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Venser either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Venser enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1819-6527.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
1819-6527.description:
Cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that leaves your graveyard this way, dealing at least 7 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

4050-6054-6290.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
4050-6054-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1339-5147-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-5147-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Insect, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1778-5852.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
803-1778-5852.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Memnite triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Memnite spells, causing the nontoken Memnite to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

1242-1323-3143-3457.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Seeker of Skybreak each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-3143-3457.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1018-1409-2288-4050-4150.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Skullwinder.
1018-1409-2288-4050-4150.description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to Tangled Colony.
Tangled Colony dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Tangled Colony triggers, creating thirteen 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eleven times by sacrificing eleven Rats, adding {6}{U}{U}{B}{R}{R}.
Activate Skullwinder by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullwinder.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Tangled Colony to your hand from your graveyard, and cause an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time, returning Shivan Meteor to your hand using Skullwinder instead.
Cast Tangled Colony by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2646-2757-5189.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
There is an additional +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control a basic land.
2646-2757-5189.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

262-859-4506.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-4506.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Auriok Champion four times.
Resolve the first Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1335-2440-2850.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2440-2850.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ivy Lane Denizen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Repeat.

500-851-2743.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Biovisionary and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
End your turn.
All the Biovisionaries trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, winning the game.

1692-2105.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Combat Celebrant.
1692-2105.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
